test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 1.
solution:
The correct answer is 'corrective'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's check each option-

 
 
• effective- successfully producing the result that you want.
 
• **ineffective**- not producing the effect or result that you want.
 
• **directive**- an official order to do something.
 
• corrective- intended to make something right that is wrong.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate word to fill in the blank 1 is 'corrective'.
 
• Thus, 'option 4' is the correct answer.

​

Correct sentence: *Reservation is a part of **corrective**__ action, which seeks to bring equality*.
